alex: Heads up — p95 for /v1/generate in the Ops dashboard jumped ~40ms at 12:03. Endpoint breakdown shows p95 ~80ms higher. Anyone see this? :thinking:

mira: I noticed. The console route-level p50/p95 are from sampled rollups. The endpoint drilldown uses per-host histograms and then merges quantiles. We're mixing derivations.

sam: Are we applying sample weighting? We recently changed the merge heuristics to weight by `request_count`. If route rollups use decaying-window aggregates and endpoint uses raw host histograms you can get inversion.

jordan: Quick check, my ad-hoc queries: ```
-- route rollup
SELECT approx_percentile(latency_ms, 0.95) FROM route_rollups WHERE route='/v1/generate' AND region='us-west';
-- host histograms
SELECT quantile(0.95) FROM host_histograms WHERE endpoint='/v1/generate' AND host='gpu-34';
``` Route returns ~120ms, host histograms show ~200ms.

alex: Exactly — two different derivations. Users expect them to match; console doesn't explain provenance today.

mira: UX options: surface a provenance pill ("sampled rollup" vs "host histogram") in the latency header, or switch route-level derivation to merged host-histograms. The latter has higher compute & storage cost.

sam: Also note quotas/routing: if routing weights shifted traffic to a handful of hosts, host histograms will be dominated by those slow hosts while sampled rollups might be underweighted. That amplifies differences.

jordan: @mira can we add an API flag like `aggregation.provenance=host_histogram|sampled_rollup` so users can request consistent derivation? Minimal API surface.

mira: We could, but it touches SDKs and console. Lighter alternative: include a `sample_origin` tag in rollup metadata and show an explain tooltip in the UI.

alex: For near-term: add a dashboard banner "Percentiles computed from X — may differ from endpoint view" and file an RFC.

platformbot: IncidentBot: Note created — INC-2026: dashboard-percentile-provenance. Assigned to @mira, @sam.

sam: :thumbsup: I'll prototype adding `sample_origin` to route rollups. Quick Q: canonical field name? `sample_origin` or `sample_source`?

jordan: We currently use `sample_origin` in trace logs. Telemetry previously used `sample_source` in a couple places. I vote `sample_origin` for consistency.

alex: Action items: 1) sam prototype `sample_origin` tag on rollups, 2) mira add short banner + provenance pill in dashboard, 3) jordan file RFC on merge heuristics and cost tradeoffs. I'll update INC-2026 with these. Thanks everyone :eyes:
